methodology: Two runs per variant in B/A/A/B order, same native executable/dependencies/harness; native DOM input 25 with 5 warmups, open-loop 80ms dispatch 35 with 5 warmups per fixture. Summary pools retained samples across both runs, not averages of percentiles.

runs.description: Native macOS WebKit, production app and real IPC in a disposable vault; DOM insertText input awaits frames; separate open-loop dispatch at 12.5 edits/s. RAF proxies exclude OS input arrival and compositor scanout.
